name: @mgpl-diagnostics/ledger-kit
description: MGPL Diagnostics accounting engine: the 28 standard account groups, ledgers, vouchers numbered per type per financial year, double-entry posting with lock dates, automatic posting for invoices and payments (a db-kit PostingHook), and books reports (trial balance, ledger statement, cash book, day book, profit & loss, balance sheet, outstanding receivables, GST summary). Integer paise, ACID on MongoDB and PostgreSQL through db-kit. Our own software; no Tally import or export.
